Marcus —

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. We locked the internal date for Stratonics’ evaluation demo next Thursday (Sept 2) and wanted to confirm a couple of operational details before we finalize the invite:

- Is your CTO (or a principal engineering sponsor) available for a 30-min CIO/CTO handshake at the start? Our exec prefers to have a senior tech presence for the first 20–30 minutes.
- We have a travel note — our CTO, Daniel Cho, will be onsite for related meetings that week but may arrive late afternoon. Is there any flexibility to shift the CTO handshake to 2:30–3:00pm PT if needed?
- Sensitive ask: Stratonics execs prefer no recording for the first 15 minutes (internal strategy discussion). Can Redwood agree to disable recording for the initial handshake and enable it for the product demo after the executive handoff?

If you can confirm by EOD Monday it helps our logistics team. Also appreciate any suggested run-of-show you intend to use.

Thanks —
Elena Park
Director, Strategic Ops

I’m attaching a short concierge run-of-show (stub) with who will speak in the handshake and the proposed recording toggle point. Can you confirm Daniel Cho’s expected arrival window so we can choose the appropriate backup (my director Lauren Bishop can cover the handshake if the CTO is delayed)?

1) You confirm preferred slot (1:00pm PT or 2:30pm PT) and whether Daniel will be in-person or remote.
2) We will send a calendar invite with the recording setting noted and a security note for the first 15 min.
3) If Daniel is delayed, Lauren Bishop will step in for the handshake — I’ll loop her on the invite.
